analysis.title: GS Laicini - Prime HFs Update at US Close 15 Oct 2026
key_insights: Hedge fund performance fell again at the US close on Oct 15. Momentum fell further and crowding losses deepened, with the worst pain in systematic (quant) funds. Fundamental L/S managers recovered a little from their intraday low.
Global Fundamental L/S managers were down 0.5% at the close (-0.8 SD move) and are up 10% YTD.
Global Systematic L/S managers were down 1.4% (-3.7 SD), their worst day since Aug 19. They remain up 20% YTD.
Multi-Strats (equity portfolio, 4.5x leverage) were down 1.2% (-2.2 SD).
At the 10:30am ET intraday update, GS described a continuing market/AI sell-off: Momentum -3.4 SD, Crowded Longs -1.8 SD, and Crowded Shorts squeezing +1.2 SD, which GS reads as broader de-grossing.
Global Fundamental L/S managers were down 0.9% (-1.2 SD) at 10:30am, down every day this week, with the weekly drawdown at -2.9% and performance +9.6% YTD.
Asia-focused funds were down 2.6% (-2 SD) at 10:30am, down 6.8% MTD. They are still up 17% YTD but 23% off the late-June peak of +40%.
TMT-focused funds were down 2.0% (-1.4 SD) at 10:30am, down 4.7% over the past two sessions, and still up 11.1% YTD.
Systematic L/S managers were down 0.9% (-2.6 SD) at 10:30am, mainly from European and Asian exposure, with momentum and crowding as the key factor drivers.
From COVID through end-2025, all three broad HF strategies never fell more than 80bps on the same day. In 2026 this has happened three times: Feb 4, Jul 28 and Oct 15.
risk_factors: De-grossing across crowded longs, with crowded shorts squeezing at the same time.
Momentum factor unwind hitting systematic and multi-strat funds.
Asia-focused and TMT-focused funds are drawing down, with the market/AI sell-off continuing.
vol_and_positioning: Momentum fell 3.4 SD and Crowded Longs fell 1.8 SD at 10:30am ET on Oct 15, while Crowded Shorts squeezed +1.2 SD. GS reads this as broader de-grossing.
Crowding hurt more at the close than at the intraday update, with momentum down further and the worst losses in quant funds.
Systematic L/S managers fell 1.4% (-3.7 SD) at the close, the worst day since Aug 19.
Multi-Strats (equity portfolio, 4.5x leverage) were down 1.2% (-2.2 SD) with momentum and crowding the top factor losses.
All three broad HF strategies fell more than 80bps on the same day for the third time in 2026 (Feb 4, Jul 28, Oct 15). It never happened between COVID and end-2025.
